title: Cap. VI Arg. 13: last — foresight election overturns pure grace
pass_a_gloss: Our last argument will be of this kind: We ought not to introduce such an election as overturns the pure grace of God, and reduces the discrimination of elect and rejected to the good use of free choice: But election from foresighted faith, and non-election from foresighted unbelief, does this.
pass_b_english: Last argument: we must not bring in an election that overturns pure grace and reduces the split between elect and rejected to the good use of free choice. But election from foresighted faith — and non-election from foresighted unbelief — does exactly that.
source_text: Ultimum argumentum nostrum hujusmodi erit: Non debemus introducere talem electionem, quae puram Dei gratiam evertit, et discrimen electorum et rejectorum ad bonum usum liberi arbitrii reducit: Sed electio ex fide praevisa, et non-electio ex infidelitate praevisa hoc facit.
